description: Fallback when you cannot read the CV yourself: Jobiba's rules parser reads pasted CV text (phone, place, links, notice period, work preference, summary, skills, roles, education, certifications, languages). Without apply=true it only returns a preview; with apply=true it fills empty fields and adds new list items without overwriting anything. Returns applied, kept and skipped fields (including roles found without dates).

apply.description: true only after the user approved the preview.

name: import_cv_text
title: Build profile from CV text
